items: ENUGU STATE (PSI 9.3): House of Assembly Passes Landmark Rental Reform Bill Capping Agency Fees at 5%, Legal Fees at 10% & Freezing Rent Hikes for 4 Years
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 9.1): Inaugurates 1.5MW Government House Solar Plant, 1MW Specialist Hospital Solar & 37 World Bank Solar Mini-Grids Across 7 LGAs
EKITI STATE (PSI 8.9): Gov. Oyebanji Signs ₦415.57Bn Revised 2026 Appropriation Law, Pension Reform Amendment & Telecom Right of Way Law
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.7): Gov. Otti Opens First Continental US–Africa Trade Expo (AFRICANDO) in Umuahia & Dissolves Enyimba FC Management for Restructuring
TARABA STATE (PSI 8.5): Gov. Kefas Approves 100% Payment of Tertiary Institutions' CATA, CONTTA & Earned Academic Allowances, Urges Strike Suspension
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 8.4): Gov. Namadi Signs Two Executive Orders on Digital Farmer Registry & Market-Oriented Cooperatives for World Bank AGROW Eligibility
KEBBI STATE (PSI 8.2): President Tinubu Approves Full Operationalisation of Tsamiya Inland Dry Port Following Gov. Idris' Appeal
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 8.0): Awards University-Bound Scholarships to 60 Orphans with Starlink & Child First Software, Aligns SPIN Gender & CS-SUNN Nutrition Plans
EDO STATE (PSI 7.9): EDOHERMA Permanently Seals Defiant Unregistered Clinic, Rescues Accident Victim & NBA Benin Commends Gov. Okpebholo on Security
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 7.7): Gov. Eno Announces ₦200k–₦250k Student Bursary Hike & Donates Buses Across 3 Senatorial Districts on International Students' Day
LAGOS STATE (PSI 7.5): Confirms Dr. Tayo-Makanjuola as State Auditor-General & Permanent Secretary, Trains Auditors on AI/IFRS & Mentors 230+ Schoolboys
KWARA STATE (PSI 7.2): Gov. AbdulRazaq Presents ₦50M Equipment & Financial Grants at 2026 Kwara Students Entrepreneurship Expo
KOGI STATE (PSI 6.7): Gov. Ododo Orders Immediate Probe into Death of Nursing Student Miss Adewumi Olamide Gift at Obangede

ENUGU (PSI 9.3): The Enugu State House of Assembly passed the House Rent, Landlord and Tenant Bill backed by Gov. Peter Mbah, capping agency fees at 5%, legal fees at 10%, prohibiting rent increases for the first four years (and capping subsequent hikes at 2% or 10% post-renovation), mandating agent certification, and creating a 21-day dispute tribunal.

ZAMFARA (PSI 9.1): Power Minister Joseph Asunkanmi Tegbeh joined Gov. Dauda Lawal to inaugurate a 1.5MW solar project at Government House Gusau, a 1MW solar plant at Ahmad Sani Yariman Bakura Specialist Hospital, and 37 World Bank-backed solar mini-grids across seven LGAs.

EKITI (PSI 8.9): Gov. Biodun Oyebanji assented to the 2026 Revised Appropriation Law (retaining ₦415.57bn total budget size while adjusting recurrent to ₦268.77bn and capital to ₦146.81bn), the Ekiti State Pension Reform (Second Amendment) Law, and the Right of Way Law for telecom infrastructure.

ABIA (PSI 8.7): Gov. Alex Otti declared open the inaugural continental US–Africa Trade and Investment Conference and Expo (AFRICANDO) in Umuahia spotlighting Aba's 25-year masterplan and Export Growth Lab, while dissolving Enyimba International FC's management and technical crew for comprehensive restructuring.

TARABA (PSI 8.5): Gov. Agbu Kefas approved 100% implementation of CATA, CONTTA, Earned Academic Allowances, and related entitlements for state tertiary institution workers following SSG Chief G.T. Kataps' committee report, appealing to ASUU and JACTI to end ongoing strikes immediately.

JIGAWA (PSI 8.4): Gov. Umar Namadi signed two Executive Orders establishing the Jigawa Common Data Framework for the Digital Farmer Registry and the Market-Oriented Cooperative Development Framework, fulfilling mandatory eligibility criteria for the World Bank-supported AGROW Programme.

KEBBI (PSI 8.2): President Bola Tinubu approved Gov. Nasir Idris' request for the full operationalisation of the Tsamiya Inland Dry Port during a Birnin Kebbi engagement alongside infrastructure reviews of the Sokoto–Badagry Superhighway.

PLATEAU (PSI 8.0): Gov. Caleb Mutfwang's administration presented university-level scholarships to 60 orphans alongside Child First monitoring software and SpaceX Starlink orphanage connectivity, committed to 40% female leadership representation in the SPIN irrigation project, and mandated CSO nutrition plan registration across 17 LGAs.

EDO (PSI 7.9): EDOHERMA CEO Dr. Adesuwa Urhoghide-Edigin permanently closed the unregistered Mama Funmi Clinic in Ekiadolor over seal defiance and rescued an injured schoolgirl along the Benin-Lagos Expressway, while NBA Benin Branch commended Gov. Monday Okpebholo for curbing cultism and kidnapping and delivering the Ikpoba Hill flyover.

AKWA IBOM (PSI 7.7): Gov. Umo Eno announced a proposed bursary increase to ₦200,000 for general students and ₦250,000 for Medicine, Law, and Engineering students starting next year, reaffirmed the Education Emergency Committee, and donated three buses and a car to student leaders in Uyo.

LAGOS (PSI 7.5): Gov. Babajide Sanwo-Olu confirmed Dr. Olufunke Tayo-Makanjuola as State Auditor-General and Permanent Secretary, trained state auditors on AI auditing and IFRS S1/S2 sustainability disclosures, and mentored over 230 schoolboys across 16 schools on health and personal safety.

KWARA (PSI 7.2): Gov. AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq disbursed equipment and financial grants worth ₦50 million to outstanding student entrepreneurs during the 2026 Kwara Students Entrepreneurship Expo marking International Students' Day.

KOGI (PSI 6.7): Gov. Ahmed Usman Ododo directed Health Commissioner Dr. Abdulazeez Adams Adeiza to deploy an investigative team to Kogi State College of Nursing Sciences, Obangede, to probe the death of student Miss Adewumi Olamide Gift.
